title: feat(app-shell): Studio item toolbar — layers, references, history with rollback, audit and source on every pillar item
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoY3Lv183dpSdzAqvyvWdkwi)_

Fixes #28239

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio 的 Data、Interfaces、Automations 三个支柱，打开任一项时，项头部多出一组工具：分层、引用关系、历史（可回滚）、审计日志、源码，与 Setup 项页面右侧那套是同一批组件；这些组件搬到共享目录 `views/item-tools/`，Setup 改为从那里引用，行为不变。
- 为什么改：维护者裁决 D-5 / D-7（「setup 右侧这套界面，包括看版本历史的，本身就应该属于 studio」）：作者在 Studio 改了东西，要撤销还得跑去 Setup；后续定制卡都要在编辑处看历史和回滚。
- 风险与回滚：Setup 页面只换了引用路径、引用面板的加载搬进同语义的 hook，Setup 原有测试全部不改语义照绿；Studio 只在头部加按钮组。整个 PR 可单独回退。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/item-tools/StudioItemTools.tsx`（工具栏与回滚门槛）、`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 三处头部接线、`ResourceEditPage.tsx` 引用面板换 hook 的那几处。
- 两分钟验证：Studio 打开任一对象 / 页面 / 流程，点头部「历史」→ 选一个旧版本点回滚 → 出现应用内确认框，确认后该项重新读取；只读包里同一入口没有回滚按钮、源码只读。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Shared directory.** `LayeredDiff`, `ResourceHistoryPage` (`HistoryPanel` and the history route page), `AuditPanel` and `JsonSourceEditor` move, with their own tests, to `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/item-tools/` (`git mv`, so history follows). The references panel and its lazy scan leave `ResourceEditPage.tsx` as `item-tools/ReferencesPanel.tsx` (`ReferencesPanel` + `useReferencesScan`, the same idle / loading / loaded / error union and re-entry guard). Setup's item page imports all five from there; its behaviour is unchanged.
- **Studio item toolbar.** New `item-tools/StudioItemTools.tsx`: five icon buttons in each pillar's item-header actions slot, each opening the panel Setup's sheet holds.
  - History and Audit are offered only when `useCanReadAuthoringTrail` admits the caller, as on Setup.
  - Rollback is offered on Setup's Save gate (an authoring caller on an item that is not read-only), asks the same in-app confirm, writes through the same `client.rollback`, and bumps the pillar's own reload nonce (`objReloadNonce` / `leafReloadNonce` / `flowReloadNonce`) so the item is re-read.
  - Source edits the pillar's own draft buffer (Data's object draft, an Interfaces leaf's draft, the open flow's draft) and the pillar's autosave sends it; it is read-only on a read-only package, where the pillar has no designer for the item, and on an Interfaces object entry (the object is edited in Data), where it shows the served body.
  - Layers and Source-without-a-buffer read `client.layered(type, name, { packageId })` lazily, with an error arm and a retry.
- **Not carried over** (card item 3): Setup's autosave toggle and `DraftReviewPanel`.
- **i18n.** One contiguous `engine.studio.itemTools.*` block per pack (en, zh); every tool label reuses Setup's existing `engine.edit.*` keys.

### Move map (old path → new path)

Under `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/`:

| Old | New |
|---|---|
| `metadata-admin/LayeredDiff.tsx` | `item-tools/LayeredDiff.tsx` |
| `metadata-admin/LayeredDiff.overlayScope.test.tsx` | `item-tools/LayeredDiff.overlayScope.test.tsx` |
| `metadata-admin/ResourceHistoryPage.tsx` | `item-tools/ResourceHistoryPage.tsx` |
| `metadata-admin/AuditPanel.tsx` | `item-tools/AuditPanel.tsx` |
| `metadata-admin/AuditPanel.emptyPlaceholderAffordance-8504.test.tsx` | `item-tools/AuditPanel.emptyPlaceholderAffordance-8504.test.tsx` |
| `metadata-admin/AuditPanel.loadFailure.test.tsx` | `item-tools/AuditPanel.loadFailure.test.tsx` |
| `metadata-admin/AuditPanel.lockState.test.tsx` | `item-tools/AuditPanel.lockState.test.tsx` |
| `metadata-admin/JsonSourceEditor.tsx` | `item-tools/JsonSourceEditor.tsx` |
| `metadata-admin/JsonSourceEditor.fallback.test.tsx` | `item-tools/JsonSourceEditor.fallback.test.tsx` |
| `metadata-admin/JsonSourceEditor.monaco-export.test.tsx` | `item-tools/JsonSourceEditor.monaco-export.test.tsx` |
| `metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx` (`ReferencesState`, `ReferencesPanel`, the references loader) | `item-tools/ReferencesPanel.tsx` (`ReferencesState`, `ReferencesPanel`, `useReferencesScan`) |

Import re-paths only: `src/index.ts` (the `LayeredDiff` and `MetadataResourceHistoryPage` exports keep their names), `metadata-admin/index.ts`, `ResourceRouter.tsx`, `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`, `DraftReviewPanel.tsx`, and the tests `metadataAdminFaces.displayLocale-9909`, `useMonacoFallback.fastfail`, `useMonacoFallback.loaderRejection-11800`, `ResourceHistoryPage.rollbackConfirm-13333` (stays in `metadata-admin/`; its native-confirm file list re-pathed), and `i18n`'s `ariaLabelLiteralCensus-12145` path row.

### Size note

Rename-aware (`git diff -M --numstat`): **+900 / −186 = 1,086 lines**, under the order's ~1,500 split line, so move and wiring ship as one PR. `dispatch-gates.mjs` counts without rename detection (+3,033 / −2,319 = 5,352) and reports it over the 3,000 human-merge line; the seat reads GitHub's own additions/deletions on this PR for the landing class.

## Tests

- New `studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.itemTools-28239.test.tsx` (8 tests, real pillars and real Setup page, the metadata client doubled):
  - each of Data (`object`), Interfaces (`page`) and Automations (`flow`) shows the five buttons in order and opens all five, each reading its own door for that item (`layered` with the package, `references`, `history`, `audit`), Source holding the item's JSON, editable;
  - rollback from Studio: the in-app confirm names `object/showcase_account` and version 1, accepting calls `client.rollback('object', 'showcase_account', 1)` once, and the pillar re-reads the object;
  - a read-only package: history without rollback, Source read-only with its sentence; CONTROL: the writable package offers the two rollbacks;
  - a `setup.access`-only caller gets Layers, References and Source, not History or Audit;
  - CONTROL: Setup's item page still opens Layers, References, History, Audit and the Source tab.
- Changed: `DataPillar.headerActions-12511` — the header's control set on every tab is now the rail toggle plus the five tools (was the rail toggle alone); its docblock says why (rulings D-5 / D-7).
- Moved tests keep their bodies; only relative imports were re-pathed.

## Acceptance notes

- Interfaces keeps its existing ⋯ → View definition sheet (a source page's code editor, other items read-only JSON) beside the new Source tool, which edits the leaf's JSON. Folding the two is a follow-up for the Studio customization cards, not done here.
- `docs/adr/0005-metadata-customization-overlay.md` still names `metadata-admin/LayeredDiff.tsx`; that file is Tier H and left untouched (the claim's file surface excludes `docs/adr/**`).
- The references count badge appears after the References sheet has been opened once (the scan is lazy, as on Setup); Layers carries no overlay-count badge in Studio because Studio does not read the layers until the sheet opens.
- `views/setup/PackagedAutomationPage.tsx`, the object pickers and `ResourceEditPage.tsx`'s validation region are untouched.

## Verification

Head `b0fe67bc`, local, under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`.
